requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Where vials or label geometry are represented, they preserve the clear cylindrical glass body, plain matte charcoal cap and closed spray-vial identity. Dimensioned representations agree with a 12 mm diameter, 60 mm total height, 14 mm cap and 30 mm straight labeling zone. Flat labels are 28 mm around the cylinder by 30 mm vertically and wrap only part of the circumference. Perspective and schematic simplification are allowed; contradictory dimensions, altered container identity or incompatible label placement fail. Numerical dimensions come from the supplied facts, not measurements of the reference image.

Each board shows a closed carrier with a real opening through which identifying label areas of three separate retained vials are visible. An uncovered cutout or transparent protective film is acceptable. Contents are P01: one each F01/F02/F03; P02: one each F04/F05/F06; P03: one each F01/F03/F04; P04: one each F02/F05/F06. Printed simulations of a window, identification visible only after opening, obscured vial identities, incorrect stock or unsupported loose vials fail.

Connected, opened and separated views demonstrate a physical joining feature or holder that can be disengaged and reused. The closed combined assembly has stated dimensions no greater than 192 W x 84 D x 90 H mm, and either pack can open independently. Views consistently account for six filled, unopened vials: F01/F02/F03 once each in P01 and three F01 in R01. If replacement use is depicted, a sealed vial replaces a matching empty position, other discovery vials remain in place and unused refill stock stays identifiable and protected. Mere adjacency, destructive separation, blocked independent access, missing stock, reassigned stock or pouring as the refill mechanism fails.

Each board gives actual fixture dimensions within 360 W x 240 D x 260 H mm and dimensioned placement using the chosen package footprints. The core contains two complete P01 packs, three complete S01 cartons and one complete R01 pack; the expanded arrangement contains two complete P03 packs, two complete S04 cartons and one complete R03 pack. A readable NOTEFORM header, supporting surfaces and credible removal access are visible. Arrangement and fixture construction may vary; incorrect inventory, unsupported packages, overlapping footprints or inaccessible removal fails.

The identification key accounts for F01 CITRUS SHADE, F02 LINEN AIR, F03 CEDAR STILL, F04 FIG PATH, F05 IRIS DUSK and F06 SALT LIGHT with readable codes and names and their selected color or symbol assignments. The designer chooses the assignments. Missing fragrances, incorrect code/name pairings or identification relying solely on color or symbols fails.

A, B and C are identifiable proposals, each explaining its P01 window, vial retention, opening operation and physical P01/R01 grouping. Comparison reveals distinct construction choices and graphic treatments, while preserving the fixed vial and stock requirements. Recolored duplicates or proposals omitting a required mechanism fail.

The document identifies one of A, B or C as the selected proposal and records the applicable material names, board weight, thickness, actual finished and unfolded dimensions, vial clearances, physical window geometry, opening method and reversible grouping mechanism. The selection is traceable to the three preceding proposals. Values must support the stated vial, package and grouping envelopes; unspecified values, inconsistent mechanisms or selection of an unrepresented direction fails.

Structural artwork develops the specified construction with dimensioned S01/P01/R01 flat layouts, cuts, folds, glue regions, a physical P01 window and sections demonstrating separation, retention and clearance for full vials and caps. It repeats the specification's materials, board weight, thickness and actual finished dimensions. Each packaging board repeats its applicable material names and finished dimensions, within 38 W x 32 D x 82 H mm for singles and 96 W x 42 D x 82 H mm for three-vial packs. Dimensions use mm outside consumer artwork. Contradictory specifications, missing construction information or interference between full vials and the structure fails.

The sheet assigns the required English copy to vial labels and the applicable S01, P01 and R01 surfaces. Names, code/name associations, quantities and descriptions match 03-fragrances.md and 04-combinations.md; mandatory brand, category, safety and refill instructions match the Exact printed content table in 01-client-facts.en.md. Discovery copy identifies every contained fragrance and includes all corresponding rear descriptions. Missing text, inaccurate transcription or placement on a surface inconsistent with the client records fails.

Every board provides a closed assembly and readable flat front and rear panels. Fronts carry NOTEFORM and the record's applicable exact name: singles also carry their fragrance code, Single trial and 1 x 2 mL; discoveries carry Discovery set and 3 x 2 mL; refills carry their fragrance code, Refill set and 3 x 2 mL. Discovery panels identify all three contents by exact code and name. Rear descriptions match 03-fragrances.md for the pack's contents. Every rear prints 'For external use only.' and 'Keep away from eyes.'; refill rears also print 'Sealed replacement vials. Replace the matching empty vial; do not pour.' and 'For retained NOTEFORM discovery carriers.' S01–S06 contain their corresponding single fragrance; R01 shows three F01 vials and R03 three F03 vials. Artwork agrees with both the copy sheet and client records; an incorrect copy sheet does not excuse an error. Layout and line breaks may vary, but missing, altered, mismatched or unreadable mandatory copy fails.

The board contains one readable flat label and a corresponding applied-vial view for each of F01 CITRUS SHADE, F02 LINEN AIR, F03 CEDAR STILL, F04 FIG PATH, F05 IRIS DUSK and F06 SALT LIGHT. Each 28 by 30 mm label carries NOTEFORM, its exact code/name and 2 mL. Applied views preserve their flat label's identity and fit the fixed partial-wrap label area. Missing or duplicated fragrances, mismatched applied labels or illegible mandatory text fails.

The presentation contains at least eight pages and names the selected A, B or C direction on page 1. Its material names and actual finished package dimensions match the structural specification. Its reproduced copy preserves the NOTEFORM hierarchy and correct fragrance code/name identification. Additional pages are allowed; missing required facts, incorrect selection or contradictory dimensions fails. Film duration and visible reuse are assessed by their dedicated checks.

The presentation visibly incorporates identifiable artwork or readable excerpts from every listed source, including all three directions and a sequence of actual film frames. The reproduced counter arrangement preserves two P01, three S01 and one R01 in the delivered arrangement. Cropping, scaling and page composition may change if the source remains recognizable. Merely naming an artifact, substituting a different design or omitting a source fails.

Review the entire film and its runtime: it lasts 10 seconds and develops the specified direction and delivered package geometry. It shows P01 closed with identifying portions of all three labels visible, independent opening of P01 and R01, and reversible physical grouping consistent with the documented 192 W x 84 D x 90 H mm maximum. The sequence accounts for the complete unopened six-vial stock, with F01/F02/F03 once each in P01 and three F01 in R01. Editing and camera choices may vary; omitted operations, stock discontinuity, incompatible geometry, a simulated window or incorrect duration fails.

identityConsistency.comparisonScope: compare only the supplied vial itself, its clear cylindrical glass body, its diameter-to-height proportions, the matte cap and the straight labelling zone; the printed label artwork, its colours and typography, and the cartons and display built around the vial are the design work

carryThrough.notes: The structural artwork board repeats these facts and dimensions its cuts, folds, glue areas, window and interior clearances; the packaging boards and presentation repeat the material names and finished dimensions.

Flat label artwork fits 28 by 30 mm and carries 2 mL; packaging artwork reproduces its applicable names, category labels, quantities, descriptions and rear-panel copy from the copy sheet and attached records.
